position: Verify a provider contract without pretending an identity provider is connected
headline: Only short-lived pseudonymous AAL2 sessions can reach a bounded reviewer capability.
copy: The contract defines the claims and capability policy a future identity provider must satisfy. It does not authenticate a real person or create an account.

postures.title: Issuer and audience
postures.copy: Claims must be bound to one reviewed provider and VedaPath audience.

postures.title: Assurance
postures.copy: One-hour maximum sessions and revocation are mandatory.

postures.title: Reviewer roles
postures.copy: Four roles map only to review capabilities.

postures.title: Identity provider
postures.copy: The validator is a contract, not live authentication.

flow.title: Verify
flow.copy: Check issuer, audience, subject, time, assurance, and revocation.

flow.title: Map
flow.copy: Translate accepted roles into narrow capabilities.

flow.title: Authorize
flow.copy: Allow only an explicitly mapped review operation.

flow.title: Deny
flow.copy: Keep publication, invitation, activation, and launch locked.

decisions.label: Claims contract
decisions.reason: Unsafe and identifying claims are rejected.

decisions.label: Production authentication
decisions.reason: No live issuer or account is connected.

decisions.label: Launch capabilities
decisions.reason: Roles cannot cross the pilot boundary.

locks.title: Deployment lock
locks.copy: No provider endpoint, domain, runtime, or credential is active.

locks.title: Identity lock
locks.copy: The claim contract does not authenticate a real reviewer.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: Ledger semantics are verified without a connected durable provider.

locks.title: Invitation lock
locks.copy: No invitation token, participant, or external session exists.

locks.title: Public launch lock
locks.copy: Implementation readiness cannot activate a public service.

packet:
VedaPath Reviewer Identity Provider Contract
Protocol shape: OIDC-style claims
Subject: pseudonymous reviewer id
Assurance: AAL2 required
Lifetime: 60 minutes maximum
Revocation: required
Direct identity claims: rejected
Roles: observer, source reviewer, rights reviewer, release reviewer
Publish, merge, invite, activate, public launch: always denied
Identity provider connected: false
